correctness.rationale: Exact log-odds drift excludes genuine 2-cycles via strict Jensen; Coppel then proves global convergence to the interior fixed point. Exact Taylor expansion to fifth order gives the two-step cubic/quintic parabolic recurrence. The inverse-square variable has a positive constant drift and a 1/u term; summable remainder gives a finite full-parity constant. Verified coefficients and sample trajectories with the embedded checker. Endpoints and exact landing handled separately.
